payload.focus: Sprint retro: async decision widget shipped, velocity 23 points highest this quarter, Zephyr integration as key unlock
payload.rationale: This sprint retro directly touches three load-bearing concepts already in the graph: the Zephyr integration as key unlock (Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, Obs_ZephyrRateLimitResolved), the 23-point velocity metric (Obs_TinaVelocity, StyleObs_Sprint4_MetricAnchor), and the async decision widget shipping as thesis proof (Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture). I expanded the two core narratives the widget sits under — DecisionCaptureAtConsensus and DecisionsEvaporate — plus the AntiSlackPositioning thesis and its AntiPatternRealtimeChat child, since the widget is the product embodiment of that positioning. I included Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint because a retro naturally bears on next-sprint priorities, and Position_WebhookArchitecture because the Zephyr integration claim depends on the webhook architecture decision. The prior Sprint 4 retro document (Sample_Sprint4Retro_20260322) is included so passes can bind this new retro to the existing source. I deliberately did NOT expand pricing positions (PricingTwelveDollars, PricingTier25Plus), product category, or target market — the document mentions none of these and expanding them would be reaching.
